title: Actual coefficient-transition formula for tower compact support
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,\bar X,Y$, and a compactification $f=pj:X\xrightarrow{j}\bar X\xrightarrow{p}Y$, with $j$ open and $p$ proper [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$, put $A_n=O/\ell^n$, and use the constant ring sheaves $A_{n,T}$ and the derived category of semilinear coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $C\in D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(X,O))$ have constructible finite-Tor levels $C_n$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and denote its actual transition-adjoints by $\rho_{n,m}:C_n\otimes^L_{A_{n,X}}A_{m,X}\to C_m$ for $m\le n$. Let $F=Rp_{*,\bullet}j_{!,\bullet}$ be the tower functor, with evaluations $(FC)_n\cong Rf_{!,A_n}C_n$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels].

Under these canonical evaluation identifications, the actual transition-adjoint of $FC$ is
$$ (Rf_{!,A_n}C_n)\otimes^L_{A_{n,Y}}A_{m,Y}\xrightarrow{b_{A_n,A_m}(C_n)}Rf_{!,A_m}(C_n\otimes^L_{A_{n,X}}A_{m,X})\xrightarrow{Rf_{!,A_m}(\rho_{n,m})}Rf_{!,A_m}C_m. $$
Here $b$ is precisely the proper counit transpose followed by the extension-by-zero tensor comparison specified in [det-sp-reduction-direct-image]. This identification is natural in $C$, and for $r\le m\le n$ its two successive transition words equal the direct $n$-to-$r$ word, with the canonical scalar associators. The equality is an equality of the specified maps on the derived system model [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], including the proper counit and open-extension comparison; it is not an inference from faithfulness of evaluations. No flatness or finite projective dimension of $A_m$ over $A_n$ is required.

proof.text: Put $J_a=j_!^{A_a}$, $G_a=Rp_{*,A_a}$, $F_a=G_aJ_a$, and $T_T^{n,m}=(-)\otimes^L_{A_{n,T}}A_{m,T}$. Write $e^{n,m}:T_{\bar X}^{n,m}J_n\simeq J_mT_X^{n,m}$ and $\gamma^{n,m}:T_Y^{n,m}G_n\to G_mT_{\bar X}^{n,m}$ for the specified comparisons. By [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison], $\gamma$ is the transpose of the scalar-extended proper counit and $b^{n,m}(K)=G_m(e^{n,m}_K)\gamma^{n,m}_{J_nK}$. These are defined on the ambient derived categories, so using them does not assume the quotient map flat.

proof.text: Exact termwise extension by zero and its restriction-of-scalars compatibility [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero] send the semilinear transition of $C$ to its extension by zero. Its scalar-adjoint is $\sigma_{n,m}=J_m(\rho_{n,m})e^{n,m}_{C_n}$. To check the normalization, apply $j_m^*$: [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization] identifies the open units and the tensor comparison with the identity on restricted sections, so the proposed map becomes $\rho_{n,m}$, the scalar-adjoint of the original transition. Full faithfulness of $J_m$, also stated there, gives equality before restriction. The comparison $e$ of step 1 is the unique composite-left-adjoint comparison with these same units. This argument takes place on the derived system model of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], where open extension is exact and its level adjunctions are the ordinary ones.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] with $u=p$ and $N=j_{!,\bullet}C$. Its direct-image transition formula is $G_m(\sigma_{n,m})\gamma^{n,m}_{J_nC_n}$: the mate there has transpose $T_{\bar X}^{n,m}(\varepsilon^{A_n})$ under the balanced tensor/pullback identification, exactly $\gamma$ of step 1. The model's evaluations preserve these counits and the actual transitions. The evaluation isomorphisms are those of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], since both use exact termwise $j_!$ followed by the canonical derived direct image. Substituting step 2 gives
$$G_mJ_m(\rho_{n,m})G_m(e^{n,m}_{C_n})\gamma^{n,m}_{J_nC_n}=F_m(\rho_{n,m})b^{n,m}(C_n).$$
This proves the required equality of specified maps; it uses no detection of equality by evaluations.

proof.text: The transition maps of $C$ and the comparisons $e,\gamma,b$ are natural by [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] and [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison]. Applying these naturality squares to the two factors $F_m(\rho_{n,m})b^{n,m}(C_n)$ proves naturality in $C$. In particular the formula holds for arbitrary, possibly noninvertible, input reductions; no normalization of $C$ has been used.

proof.text:
Write $T^{m,r}$ for scalar extension and $\delta_{n,m}=F_m(\rho_{n,m})b^{n,m}(C_n)$. Suppress associators only in the next display. Naturality of $b^{m,r}$ at $\rho_{n,m}$ gives
$$\delta_{m,r}T^{m,r}(\delta_{n,m})=F_r(\rho_{m,r}T^{m,r}\rho_{n,m})\,b^{m,r}(T^{n,m}C_n)T^{m,r}(b^{n,m}(C_n)).$$
The input cocycle of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] says $\rho_{m,r}T^{m,r}\rho_{n,m}=\rho_{n,r}\alpha_{X,C_n}$. The coefficient cocycle of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image] says
$$F_r(\alpha_{X,C_n})b^{m,r}(T^{n,m}C_n)T^{m,r}(b^{n,m}(C_n))=b^{n,r}(C_n)\alpha_{Y,F_nC_n}.$$
Thus the displayed composite equals $\delta_{n,r}\alpha_{Y,F_nC_n}$, as required. The rings $A_a$ are finite commutative $\ell$-primary rings; $C_n$ is bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude by hypothesis, so the cited coefficient cocycle applies. Its naturality is the ambient naturality of step 1. The associators and their naturality are those of [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]. Equal indices give the tensor unit identifications and the original transition. Every equality is in the specified derived system calculus already used in step 3.
